content.text:
The Soundprint redesign is still complete and uncommitted. Playback motion now follows the same audio clock, and reduced motion keeps the finished route, marker, progress, and text in place.

When a result appears, the hero route draws once and the page settles with a short fade. The journey route is already the finished stroke. The walker steps only while that audio is playing, the route is on screen, and the page is visible. Only the marker at the current time pulses, and it pulses once. While audio plays, the hero cover holds a steady glow and the active moment’s waveform grows. Chapter and current-moment text cross-fades when the line changes. Hiding the page pauses that work. There is no scrolling effect, parallax, flashing loop, WebGL, Lottie, or new animation dependency.

Against the redesign build, CSS went from 21.24 kB (gzip 4.81 kB) to 22.39 kB (gzip 5.02 kB), and JavaScript went from 327.07 kB (gzip 98.96 kB) to 327.16 kB (gzip 98.99 kB). HTML stayed 1.60 kB (gzip 0.74 kB). One warm throttled sample, at 1.6 Mbps down, 750 kbps up, 150 ms latency, and 4× CPU, reached the landing in 1477 ms and the studio in 4084 ms. Encoded resource bytes were 0 because the preview assets were already cached. That is one observation, not a Lighthouse score.

Typecheck, lint, formatting on the edited files, and the production build passed. Playwright passed the motion, playback, marker, recap, studio, release-accessibility, and phase-1 suites. In the browser, Play started the single audio element, the cover glow appeared, seeking to the turn showed “Now playing Corner. Turn. Melody changed direction.” at 0:18, and Pause left the walker still with the glow gone.

Notes for this slice are in `Docs/HANDOFF_2.md`. Nothing was committed. Suggested subject: `Polish Soundprint motion around the shared audio clock`.

### Community Wisdom: [Every animation in our app is declared paused, and one CSS selector is the play button](https://dev.to/daniel_pertu/every-animation-in-our-app-is-declared-paused-and-one-css-selector-is-the-play-button-5g00)
> **Source**: [daniel_pertu](https://dev.to/daniel_pertu)
> **Tags**: `css`, `react`, `animation`, `webdev`
>
> The published summary describes keyframes with no animation library, a figure that moves only while it is visible, `pathLength` as the draw unit, and a chart that is already on screen and therefore should not animate. That matches keeping the journey route drawn and letting the walker run only during visible playback. [Respect reduced motion (Web HIG tip #9)](https://dev.to/frozonfreak/respect-reduced-motion-web-hig-tip-9-1mpn) makes the paired point that a slide that feels smooth can be harmful for someone with a vestibular disorder, which is why the reduced-motion result is the finished state.
>
> 🔗 [Read Full Discussion](https://dev.to/daniel_pertu/every-animation-in-our-app-is-declared-paused-and-one-css-selector-is-the-play-button-5g00)
